svg.text: CELL_V1 — Stacked Build (A over B over C)
Mechanically stacked instead of side-by-side — electrically IDENTICAL to cell_v1_schematic.svg.
Position never entered the math, only the wiring did. Stacking rule below is generalized from
BRAIN_CUBE_STACK.md (written for a different cell type — same principle; this exact geometry is new/untested).
Stacking rule: one solid spine, no capacitor anywhere in it, one I₀ meter at the very bottom (home end).
Each layer defaults to STAY. A lean on one layer must never require another layer to change — if
it does, it's wired wrong. Every layer's gate-bias network + 1kΩ load is the same as the flat sheet.
RED
BLUE
BLACK
Layer A — top
AO3401A P-MOS Q1 + 2N7000 N-MOS Q2 → node PA
Gate-bias network + 1kΩ load: same as cell_v1_schematic.svg
+1 ≈ +12V · −1 ≈ −12V · STAY ≈ 0V (B, C at STAY)
Layer B — middle
AO3401A P-MOS Q3 + 2N7000 N-MOS Q4 → node PB
Gate-bias network + 1kΩ load: same as cell_v1_schematic.svg
+1 ≈ +12V · −1 ≈ −12V · STAY ≈ 0V (A, C at STAY)
Layer C — bottom
AO3401A P-MOS Q5 + 2N7000 N-MOS Q6 → node PC
Gate-bias network + 1kΩ load: same as cell_v1_schematic.svg
+1 ≈ +12V · −1 ≈ −12V · STAY ≈ 0V (A, B at STAY)
All three local BLUE taps ARE the STAR node (ONE_WAVE_CELL.md §1: "STAR = G = BLUE") —
no separate star wire to add. The three loads already converge on the one BLUE spine.
I₀ at the bottom of the spine reads the SUM of whichever layers are active.
One layer +1, both others STAY: I₀ ≈ +12.6mA — same number as the single-station sheet,
since idle layers contribute leakage only. Two layers driven at once should sum at the spine
(roughly the two currents added) — that combined case hasn't been bench-verified, so treat
it as a prediction to check, not a promised number.
Both-ON is still illegal on EVERY layer, independently — stacking does not change that fault.
Still invisible to I₀ (runs RED → Q → node → Q → BLACK on that one layer, never touches BLUE) —
watch heat, smell, or current-limit per layer, same as the flat build.
Never put a capacitor anywhere in the vertical RED/BLUE/BLACK spine.
1Ω
I0 here — ONE meter for the whole stack
All three rails continue down
to the real ±12V/common supply.
One-Wave Science — Virtual_Breadboard/09_TESTS. Build and pass each layer's own receipt (per cell_v1_schematic.svg)
BEFORE stacking the next layer on top. Per-layer circuit is verified (test 24); this 3-layer spine assembly is new
and untested — a wiring plan, not yet a bench-confirmed stack.
